name: algorithm-visualizer
description: Interactive visualizer for algorithms and data structures implemented in C, with a sandboxed C playground and a GDB-based visual debugger.

scripts.build: npm run build:clib && npm run build -w @av/server && npm run build -w @av/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:clib && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @av/server" "npm run dev -w @av/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:c && npm run test:ts
